title: Clinicly
summary: Clinic appointments with doctors, a front desk and visit notes.
description: Patients find a doctor and book a slot; doctors work a day timeline and write visit notes; the front desk checks people in. A rule refuses overlapping appointments and bookings outside clinic hours, reminders go out hourly, and the desk can never read visit notes.
roles_summary: Patients sign up. Doctors and the front desk work the schedule.
includes: Find a doctor and book a slot
Doctor day timeline and visit notes
highlights: Rule: no overlapping appointments, clinic hours only
